summary: Fossil occurrences (PBDB, e.g. 211,953 for Bivalvia), BioTIME 2.0 abundance series (CC BY) and the Open Tree synthetic tree supply the pieces for tracking declines against relatedness, and Dryad has single-study invasion and relatedness data, but no dataset found links an expanding form to the fate of its nearest relatives.
next_step: Choose clades or invasions where both phylogeny and before/after abundance exist (e.g. a BioTIME study with congeners) and pre-register the sister-versus-distant comparison; resolve fossil sister pairs from a taxonomy plus PBDB ranges.
obstacles_confirmed: Direct observations of speciation coincident with competitor extinction are rare.
Fossil sister-species pairs are rarely resolved.
